title: $\nabla$Mimic: Ultra-Efficient Humanoid Control with Differentiable Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policy learning is dominated by zeroth-order methods such as PPO, which treat the simulator as a black box and pay for it with enormous sample counts. First-order policy learning differentiates through the dynamics, but on contact-rich whole-body control it has rarely worked: its gradients explode. A recent world-model method showed that derivative information can make humanoid motion tracking far more efficient, using surrogate gradients of a learned model. We show that exact gradients of the simulator itself do better, once two obstacles are removed. Exact gradients contain rare unbounded samples, because contact dynamics is not differentiable everywhere and its derivative diverges near some events; and they are expensive, because the simulator's adjoint has to replay the contact solve.   $\nabla$Mimic bounds these samples with median-relative per-sample gradient clipping at every step of the backward pass, and reuses each cost

translated_title: ∇Mimic：基于可微分仿真的超高效人形机器人控制
translated_abstract: 机器人策略学习目前由PPO等零阶方法主导，这类方法将仿真器视为黑盒，并为此付出巨大的样本量代价。一阶策略学习通过对动力学进行微分来学习，但在接触丰富的全身控制任务上鲜有成功：其梯度会爆炸。最近一种世界模型方法表明，导数信息可以让基于学习模型的代理梯度大幅提升人形机器人运动跟踪的效率。我们证明，一旦排除两个障碍，仿真器本身的精确梯度效果更好。精确梯度中包含罕见的无界样本，因为接触动力学并非处处可微，其导数会在某些事件附近发散；同时精确梯度计算代价高昂，因为仿真器的伴随方法必须重放接触求解过程。∇Mimic通过在反向传播的每一步采用基于中位数的逐样本梯度裁剪来限制这些无界样本，并复用每次代价计算（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ∇Mimic通过逐样本梯度裁剪和伴随计算复用等手段克服了接触动力学的梯度爆炸与计算开销问题，利用仿真器的精确梯度实现了远比PPO等零阶方法高效的人形机器人控制策略学习。
en_tdlr: ∇Mimic overcomes gradient explosion and computational overhead in contact dynamics through per-sample gradient clipping and adjoint computation reuse, leveraging exact simulator gradients to achieve humanoid control policy learning far more efficiently than zeroth-order methods like PPO.
